seo.description: Essaouira beach guide: long Atlantic sand for walks, kite and sunset. Wind conditions, swimming tips and how to reach the shore from the medina.
seo.keywords: Essaouira beach, Atlantic beach Morocco, kite Essaouira, Essaouira sand

name: Essaouira Beach
hero_subtitle: A wide Atlantic beach for long walks, wind sports and sunset — the open shore beside the white medina.

overview.title: Sand, wind and open horizon
overview.p1: Essaouira’s city beach stretches wide along the Atlantic just outside the medina. It is made for walking, photography and wind sports more than for still-water swimming.
overview.p2: Conditions change with the ocean. Swimming is best when the sea is calmer; always respect flags and local advice. The alizé is part of the experience — bring a layer for after sunset.
overview.p3: Use it for a half-day of shore time between medina mornings and port evenings.

1.title: Fresh start
1.desc: Cooler air and long empty stretches.

food.title: Food near the Beach
food.p1: Beach cafés and the short walk back to medina or port tables.
food.li2: Port grilled fish a short walk north.
food.li3: Medina restaurants for a sheltered table.
food.li5: Wind can cool drinks and food fast.
food.p2: Cash is handy at smaller cafés.

1.title: Access
1.desc: Easy walk or short taxi from the medina gates toward the shore.

2.title: Wind & sun
2.desc: Alizé is strong — jacket and high SPF.

3.title: Swimming
3.desc: Only when conditions and flags allow; Atlantic swell can be serious.

q1.question: Is swimming safe?
q1.answer: When the sea is calm and flags allow. The Atlantic can be rough — check locally.

q2.question: Far from the medina?
q2.answer: A short walk or quick taxi from the main gates.

q3.question: Good for families?
q3.answer: For walks and play on sand yes; swimming only in safe conditions.

q4.question: Kite sports?
q4.answer: Essaouira is known for wind sports when conditions line up — use reputable schools.

q5.question: Best season?
q5.answer: Spring and autumn for pleasant air; summer is lively but windy.
